name: Cloudreve-Pro
description: Self-hosted file management and cloud storage, with the Pro features for free

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database, Redis, uploaded files (Local storage policy), avatars, thumbnails, conf.ini and settings.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Cloudreve Pro web app, API and WebDAV, published on host as 6127

ports.name: Port 6888
ports.description: aria2 BitTorrent and DHT port (tcp and udp), published on host as 6128. Only used for remote downloads.

ports.name: Port 6888
ports.description: aria2 BitTorrent and DHT port (tcp and udp), published on host as 6128. Only used for remote downloads.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you open Cloudreve Pro at, like http://your-server-ip:6127. Share links, WebDAV and emails use it. Change localhost to your server IP, or to your own domain if you put Cloudreve Pro behind HTTPS. Only used on the first start; change it later in the admin panel (Settings, Site URL).
